dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored annuli are visible on the mid-lateral flank. The perimeters exhibit jagged, high-frequency spatial variation with a sharp gradient transition from a low-intensity dark gray exterior to a high-intensity off-white boundary, enclosing a lower-intensity center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of high-intensity, non-gradient pixel clusters (solid spots) located primarily in the spaces between macro-annuli and extending towards the dorsal ridge and posterior peduncle.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the primary five macro-annuli on the central flank form a non-uniform hexagonal pattern with greater horizontal elongation along the anterior-posterior axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five distinct, high-contrast dark vertical slots on the anterior flipper corresponding to anatomical digits.
